title.narrative: Blue Economy Strategy - prioritized implementation plan (BESPIP)

description.narrative:
Develop a prioritized, costed and sequenced implementation plan for Ghana's Blue Economy Strategy (BESPIP), and strengthen the institutional capacity of the Blue Economy Commission to effectively oversee and coordinate its execution
The strategy operationalizes these six (6) keys thematic areas that define Ghana’s Blue Economy space: • Blue Wealth: Driving sustainable growth through ocean-based sectors such as fisheries, aquaculture, tourism, shipping, renewable energy, and marine biotechnology. • Blue Health: Protecting, restoring, and regenerating aquatic ecosystems to ensure ecological balance and climate resilience. • Blue Knowledge: Advancing research, innovation, data systems, and ocean literacy to support evidence-based planning and local capacity. • Blue Finance: Mobilizing and aligning public and private capital through innovative instruments to unlock investment in blue sectors. • Blue Equity: Ensuring social inclusion of vulnerable groups such as women, youth, and People with Disabilities (PWDs, gender equity, community empowerment, and benefit-sharing in blue economy development. • Blue Safety and Security: Securing aquatic spaces through effective maritime surveillance, inland water safety, and regional cooperation.
